documents.title: Results For The Quarter Ended 30 June 2026
Board Meeting Intimation for Considering Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The First Quarter Ended On 30Th June 2026

analysis.summary: Kernex Microsystems reported significant financial growth for the nine months ended December 2024, with revenue increasing by 929% year-on-year. The company is actively executing multiple railway safety projects, including TCAS implementation and Automatic Block Signalling. Management provided specific timelines for project completions and product development milestones through 2025. The company maintains an order book valued at 2,124.16 Crores. Kernex Microsystems shared its conference presentation detailing its operations in railway safety systems, specifically highlighting its Kavach product capabilities, production capacities, and ongoing projects.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian Railway Network is expected to complete TCAS implementation by 2030 to 2032.
demand_outlook.quote:
Entire Indian Railway Network – 85000 KM
Expected to complete by 2030 to 2032

demand_outlook.claim: Indian Railways Pink book has planned execution of ~Rs 35,000 Crores opportunity for Kavach for the next 5 years.
demand_outlook.quote: Railway’sPinkbookhasalready plannedanexecutionof ~Rs 35,000 Crores Opportunity Kavachfornext5 yrs

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed production capacity of 450 Kavach units per month.
The total value of the company's order book is 2,124.16 Crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Total Value of order book as on: 2,124.16 Crs

orders_capacity.claim: Production capacity is 100 Kavach Units per Month, which can scale up to 250 Units per Month.
orders_capacity.quote: • 100 Kavach Units/Month , can scale up to 250 Units/Month

orders_capacity.claim: Production capacity is 10 Level Crossing Gates per Month, which can scale up to 25 Units per Month.
orders_capacity.quote: • 10 Level Crossing Gates/Month, Can scale up to 25 Units/Month

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured an order for the upgradation of Kavach Version 3.2 to 4.0 in the South Central Railway section for Rs. 21.03 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: KERNEX-VRRC JV has bagged order for Upgradation of Kavach Version 3.2 to 4.0 in Sadashivpet Road (Excluding) - Bidar - Parli Vaijnath - Parbhani(Excluding) Section of South Central Railway for an amount of Rs. 21.03 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Kernex Microsystems and KEC International secured two contracts for the North Central Railway section with a combined value of approximately Rs. 536 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Kernex Microsystems and KEC International have formed a consortium and successfully secured two significant contracts with a combined value of approximately Rs.536 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: The company received an order from Chittaranjan Locomotive Works for the supply and installation of 2,500 Loco TCAS units valued at approximately Rs. 2041.40 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Total no. of units to be supplied is for 2,500 with a value of approximately Rs.2041.40 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured a contract valued at approximately Rs. 325.33 crores for the supply and installation of Kavach across South Eastern Railway divisions.
orders_capacity.quote: Kernex Microsystems (India) Limited, in consortium with MRT Signals Limited, has successfully secured a major contract valued at approximately ₹325.33 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not declare any dividend for the financial year 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: During the period under review, the Directors of the Company have not declared any dividend for the financial year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to risks including fluctuations in earnings, competition, and government policies.
risks_headwinds.quote:
The risks and uncertainties relating to these statements
include, but are not limited to, risks and uncertainties regarding fluctuations in earnings, our ability to manage growth, competition (both domestic and international), economic
growth in India and abroad, ability to attract and retain highly skilled professionals, time and cost over runs on contracts, our ability to manage our international operations,
government policies and actions regulations, interest and other fiscal costs generally prevailing in the economy.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's shares are traded under the trade-to-trade category due to non-dematerialization of promoter shareholding.
risks_headwinds.quote: In accordance with SEBI Circular No. Cir/ISD/3/2011, the entire shareholding of Promoters/Persons Acting in Concert (PACs) has not been dematerialized. Consequently, the stock exchanges have placed the trading of the Company’s shares under the trade-to-trade category.

management_commitments.claim: The GZB – CNB section of the NCR A project is expected to be completed by June 2025.
management_commitments.quote:
NCR A: GZB – CNB (GZB – CNB by June 2025, Supply Completed, 70% Execution
completed)

management_commitments.claim: The Automatic Block Signalling project is scheduled for completion in December 2025.
management_commitments.quote: Project will be completed as per schedule-Dec 2025

management_commitments.claim: Installation for the CLW project is scheduled to start in June 2025.
The company expects to complete the development of the Network Management System (NMS) by June 2025.
management_commitments.quote: Development of NMS – Prototype Developed and Testing in progress (TDC – June 2025)

management_commitments.claim: Diversification efforts will be translated to revenue in FY24-25.
management_commitments.quote: #2 Diversification efforts will be translated to revenue in FY24-25

management_commitments.claim: The company appointed Mr. D S Rao as Secretarial Auditor for a period of five consecutive financial years.
management_commitments.quote: Mr. D S Rao (C.P.No.14487), Company Secretary in Practice be and is hereby appointed as Secretarial Auditor of the Company for a period of 5 (Five) consecutive financial years i.e., from the FY 2025-26 to FY 2029-30

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
